name: r10-onewave-gs-sdisp
author: solx-loop
description: Exploration of "one resident wave of fat CTAs" (explore:one-wave-fat). The idea: launching and retiring CTAs costs time on B200, so a grid of exactly 148 x resident CTAs, each streaming many rows, should cut fixed cost and CTA overhead. Probes on the rented B200 (harness timing) falsified it. The one-shot grid already hides CTA launch and retire. One-wave grids tie at 12.6-101 MB and are 11-15% slower at 201-805 MB. That holds whether a CTA streams a contiguous chunk or strides across the grid,
